commit_note: source_commit is the pipeline code the measurement ran on; run_commit is the checkout the vendored script was rerun from. They are the same commit.
units: Counts are practitioners. Fields ending _pct are percentages, and in `change` their values are differences in percentage points.

tier_notes.resolved_alias, resolved_name_state, res: split of resolved; not added again
tier_notes.name_candidate_only: excluded from reach: an endpoint exists under a matching name with nothing deterministic tying it to the organization

question: Did Pennsylvania endpoint reach fall between the 2026-08-20 and 2026-10-07 NDH releases when both are measured by the same method on consistent inputs?
method: The current connectivity chain (H50, H51, H53, then state_connectivity.py pa --no-geo) was run on each release from the local parquet export, read through DuckDB in place of BigQuery. Practitioner and organization state came from the physical address (the first entry typed physical or both, else use work, else the first; FHI-84) on both releases. Vendor endpoint files (2026-10-26 download), the NPPES corporate-parent snapshot, the CMS enrollment crosswalk, the hospital ownership crosswalk and the H47 rural file were held constant, so the difference isolates the change on the NDH side.

superseded_comparison.note: The published ledgers read 18.7% (2026-08-20, built 2026-10-13) and 15.8% (2026-10-07, before FHI-73). The August file used H53 organization-resolution and enrollment-endpoint CSVs last written on 2026-08-16, before the 2026-08-20 reload, so its H53 side was computed on the 2026-05-08 release. That pair mixes releases and methods and should not be cited as a change.

limits: Run with --no-geo. The summary, funnel and confidence bands do not depend on the county layer.
Vendor files were held at one download, so vendor-side change between August and October is excluded by design.

BigQuery SQL was run through DuckDB with a small set of rewrites. The 2026-10-07 run reads 49,997 any route and 6,381 deterministic, against 49,995 and 6,352 in the published ledger for the same release, on the same practitioner count (225,413 and 225,413). The difference is the vendor files: this comparison holds one later download for both releases, and the ledger reads the published H51 file.
